title: Wave Tax Landing Origami
alt: The Wave tax-season landing page on full-bleed blue with higher fidelity paper creatures: a dragon folded from a printed CRA T2 form, with crisp flat facets, pleated wings, fine ruled print, real lighting and a soft shadow, sways beside the headline File your taxes without fear, then unfolds in stop motion into a flat sheet of the form.

title: Postmark Awards Unboxing 3D
alt: A low poly 3D render of the Postmark Awards recipient box on a flat deep brand purple ground: a plain kraft mailer opens to a recess holding a black rigid box in a charcoal slip sleeve with a small white Postmark stamp in the middle and the POSTMARK AWARDS 2026 logotype on its edge; the box lifts out and lands, the sleeve slides off to show the lid, where the stacked 2026 outlines are debossed in metallic foil, the lid lifts away and a thick glass Postmark porcupine etched GROWTH AWARD / RAMP on the back with purple and red glass stamps on its quills with glass stamps skewered on its quill tips is pulled up out of its stepped well on a red ribbon in a burst of light and sparkles, spins round so the camera can close in on the engraving on its back, spins back to the front, then it all rewinds to the open mailer.

title: Thread Always-On Reel
alt: A vertical personal conference film for one Thread attendee, built from their ticket, saved sessions, booth taps and live Q&A in yellow, ink and cream with stretched Instrument Serif headlines and a hairline grid: it opens on a stepped calligraphy capital with their name, counts up how many years they came back, picks out the track they are a real aficionado of, lists the sessions they attended, fills a grid of booth stamps and a crowd of dots with them in it, then ends on a Save your seat call to action, beside controls to switch the film between Before, During, After and Extra phases and change the attendee.

title: Lob Mail Call
alt: A folded four page community newspaper called The Mail Call, set from Lob's State of Direct Mail 2026 article on mint newsprint in navy ink with mint accents and Thread conference touches: Pinyon Script callouts, a hairline frame and grid and star dividers. It floats on dark navy and turns as if dragged from the outside spread, a Classifieds back page beside a front page with a huge condensed MAILBOX MOMENT headline, to the inside spread of pages two and three, and back.

title: Wave File Without Fear
alt: A Wave tax-season landing page for Canadians with a full-bleed bright blue hero headlined File your taxes without fear, where a paper scorpion folded from a printed CRA PD7A payroll form sways beside the headline and a Download the tax checklist link, then unfolds into a still, flat sheet whose print turns into the next form before it refolds into the next creature: a three-headed T2 dragon, a T5018 spider and a T2125 cobra.

title: Wave Tax Weave Walkthrough
alt: A three-stage walkthrough of a Figma Weave paid ads pipeline for Wave's File without fear tax campaign: on a dark node canvas, subject, art direction, camera and palette prompts feed a Prompt Concatenator and Prompt Enhancer into Nano Banana, which renders twelve origami creatures folded from printed CRA forms (an angular T1 dragon, a paper tiger, a T2125 cobra and three cobra heads rising out of the frame) on Wave blue, navy, pink and sky, while a copy brief runs through a copywriter node into ten headlines, both landing in a sheet and a Figma node that counts up to 480 ad variants; then a Figma page fills with 480 frames across Reel, Feed, LinkedIn and Inline templates and zooms out to show them all; then an Instagram Reel, Facebook feed post, LinkedIn sponsored post and inline article ad cycle, each creature pausing, unfolding into a perfectly still flat tax form, then refolding into a different creature.

title: Lob Get Started
alt: A dark navy Lob Get started page mockup: behind the words Build your way a wide hot pink postcard with a purple offset shadow is laid out as purple outlined boxes that hop between layouts over a hatched photo corner, then a purple panel wipes in, a nurse photo from a navy image gallery fades into the corner and white bars, check circles, a QR card and a URL pill pop in, before the page scrolls into Choose your template where the stacked insurance postcard is picked and dropped into the Visual Editor.

title: Lob Visual Editor
alt: A 16:9 Lob motion piece in the style of the Go from idea to mailbox faster sketch: Build your way blurs in word by word on purple with way in serif italic, then on navy a Lob Visual Editor window with a purple sidebar of tool pills builds a blank postcard from scratch, colour first, then the headline Welcome home, a yellow badge and a lavender image panel, before a new magenta design with a photo of a grey shingle house with a white porch is imported and dropped over it, its headline retyped to Open house this Sunday, its photo swapped to a white farmhouse lit at dusk and a first name merge variable cycling through Maya, Leo and Priya, then QR codes, PURLs and coupon codes swap onto the card and it ends on Send personalized direct mail without the technical bottlenecks with the Lob logo
